notes: Imperfective verb (ongoing or repeated action); the perfective partner is 'zgubić' (a single completed loss).
Applies to misplacing objects or shedding things, not to losing a game or match (use 'przegrywać' / 'przegrać').
With 'się' ('gubić się'), it means to get lost (lose one's way).
